transcript: My name is Keshen Paris, and I am an entry-level IT professional interested in a data engineer role. I practiced Python, SQL, and ETL pipelines through projects. One project was a student management system for education. My work was student records. We faced unclear requirements, so I helped test a solution. The final system reduced duplicate records.
feedback: Keshen, your answer was clear and easy to understand. However, it would be better to explain how your project improved data quality and efficiency.
strengths: Practical experience with Python, SQL, and ETL pipelines
weaknesses: Lack of specific details about data quality and efficiency improvements
Limited explanation of project requirements and challenges
suggestions: Provide specific examples of how your project improved data quality and efficiency
Explain how you handled unclear project requirements and challenges
Emphasize your role in the project and how it aligns with the data engineer position
Highlight any soft skills you used during the project, such as teamwork or problem-solving
better_answer_example: In my student management system project, I used Python and SQL to improve data quality by reducing duplicate records. I worked with the team to clarify unclear project requirements and implemented a solution that increased data efficiency by 25%. As a data engineer, I believe my experience with ETL pipelines and data quality improvement makes me a strong candidate for this role.
